integrity: Exact symbolic checks replayed and a full mathematical proof supplied. No infinite result inferred from finite experiments. Previous necessary-condition literature acknowledged. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite, symmetric, strictly positively weighted paths; completed fourth-order two-stage Gauss--Legendre end-step only. No claim about stages, directed graphs, or all trees. The inverse-Laplacian M-matrix obstruction is previously studied; the all-step rational-positivity classification and explicit sufficient certificates are the assessed claim. Relevant 1995/1998 source full texts were unavailable; independent publication-priority assessment remains open.
title: Unconditional fourth-order Gauss positivity on weighted paths: a four-vertex cutoff
